tasks.label: pnpm:dev
tasks.command: if [ "${IN_DEV_CONTAINER:-}" = "1" ]; then if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then fuser -k 5173/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -ti :5173 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; pnpm dev

tasks.label: docsify:serve
tasks.command: if [ "${IN_DEV_CONTAINER:-}" = "1" ]; then if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -ti :3000 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; deadline=$((SECONDS + 180)); until command -v docsify >/dev/null 2>&1; do if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$deadline" ]; then echo "docsify not found on PATH after 180s" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; docsify serve docs
